name: Small Magellanic Cloud (SMC): ON/OFF at the same altitude
question: Is there SMC gas at +120…+200 km/s above two OFFs at its own altitude?
why: On 19-11 the SMC came out at −4.6 % against fixed OFFs that sat at a different altitude: the switching baseline depends on where the dish points. Here each OFF is computed at the moment, at the SMC's altitude and 40° east and west in azimuth (further out if it lands on the LMC, the Bridge or the plane), and they alternate many times. Expected signal in the 20° beam: 0.6–0.9 % of Tsys.
